10090|0e051c59.name: Belia Thundergranite
10090|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

11028|dd2021b3.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|dd2021b3.text: I'd love to teach you! Show my sister she's not the only one who knows a thing or two about engineering...

11029|58429543.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|58429543.text: Close, but no cigar! I'm afraid you'll have to talk to my sis, Jemma first. After she's gone over the basics with you, come see me and I'll show you the juicy stuff!

1231|117e1541.name: Grif Wildheart
1231|117e1541.text: Before beginning a hunt, it is wise to ask someone what you are looking for before you begin looking for it.

1569|e2fc85be.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
1569|e2fc85be.text: No other race on Azeroth has suffered as much as our people, $c. To laugh in the face of death has become second nature for all of us.

274781|61f33a42.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|61f33a42.text:
The tinkerer's craft for you is it?  No doubt ye'll want to go see Springspindle Fizzlegear in Tinker Town.  

Just head east from the gates of Ironforge, or follow the sound of the explosions.

274781|8f560eff.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

2878|0e051c59.name: Peria Lamenur
2878|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

5595|6e49a2d4.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|6e49a2d4.text:
The Inn?  Ah, ye looking to toss back some of the best ales Ironforge has to offer?  The Stonefire Tavern is where ye'll want to go.  

Ye'll find it just to the left of the entrance to Ironforge if ye be coming, or to the right if ye be going.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

291-complete.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-complete.text:
<He quickly peruses the report.>

Authority of the KING!? Has Magni taken complete leave of his senses! And that damnable Whitebeard... Taken matters into his own hands, has he? The Senate will not be pleased to hear about this, not one bit.

What, are you still here? Go, before I call the guards!
291-complete.title: The Reports

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

363-accept.name: Undertaker Mordo
363-accept.text:
About time you woke up. We were ready to toss you into the fire with the others, but it looks like you made it.

I am Mordo, the caretaker of the crypt of Deathknell. And you are the Lich King's slave no more.

Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis in the chapel at the base of the hill, he will tell you more of what you must know.
363-accept.title: Rude Awakening

363-complete.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
363-complete.text:
Another of the walking dead, hm? Must have been quite a shock, waking up in the crypt with only the cold and Mordo to greet you...

I see the confusion on your face. Let me try to explain our... situation... to you.

We have been freed from the control of the Lich King by our new leader, Lady Sylvanas. The Dark Lady guides us in our war against the hated Scourge and the holdouts of humanity who dog our every step.
363-complete.title: Rude Awakening

364-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
364-accept.text:
We Forsaken are at war with the Lich King's army of the Scourge: necromantically raised armies of the $r, foul beasts of the north, and tormented spectres.

The northern part of the village has become overrun with the Mindless Ones, and they must be destroyed. Destroy them, show them no mercy, our former brothers and sisters as they might be. The Fallen are nothing but The Lich King's slaves.
364-accept.title: The Mindless Ones

6084-accept.name: Grif Wildheart
6084-accept.text:
Those crag boars are quite burly; maybe you'd like something with a little more finesse? Alright then, I've got jus' the thing. South and east of here, you'll find large white cats called snow leopards. Just like an elegantly-carved rifle, behind their beautiful exterior lies a powerful fighter, capable of doing extreme damage. You'll find them to be much more agile an' swift than the boar you tamed.

Take this taming rod and see how you like the snow leopard.
6084-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6084-complete.name: Grif Wildheart
6084-complete.text: When I feel you've learned enough, I will grant you the ability to choose any pet of your liking.
6084-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6084-progress.name: Grif Wildheart
6084-progress.text: What do you think of the snow leopard, $N?
6084-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6085-accept.name: Grif Wildheart
6085-accept.text:
Perhaps you'd like a creature that possesses little more than brute strength. The ice claw bear is an excellent companion for a fledgling $c like yourself, and can be found east of Kharanos. Here is the taming rod; try this animal as a pet and see if ya like it!

When you return, I'll give ya the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as ya like.
6085-accept.title: Taming the Beast

6085-complete.name: Grif Wildheart
6085-complete.text:
Here you are, $N. I will now give ya the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you please.

Find yerself a good, loyal pet, and enjoy the hunt!
6085-complete.title: Taming the Beast

6085-progress.name: Grif Wildheart
6085-progress.text: Have you tamed the ice claw bear yet?
6085-progress.title: Taming the Beast

6086-accept.name: Grif Wildheart
6086-accept.text:
$N, ya now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills ta train it.

Travel to Ironforge and find the Hall of Arms. There you must speak to one of our most revered animal trainers, Belia Thundergranite. She'll give ya the power to train your new pet, so get goin', lad!

Belia is a friendly sort; you should have no problems gaining her approval. Good luck, $N.
6086-accept.title: Training the Beast

6086-complete.name: Belia Thundergranite
6086-complete.text:
A new recruit, eh? You're on your way to becoming a great $c, I see.

Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember that the key to getting the most from your new pet is to respect it and treat it well. In turn, your pet will be your most loyal friend.
6086-complete.title: Training the Beast

95041-accept.name: Jemma Quikswitch
95041-accept.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...
95041-accept.title: Data Hoarders
